methods.label: Comparison with a right angle
methods.explanation: A 120-degree angle is an obtuse angle. It is 30 degrees larger than a right angle.
methods.levelReason: The calculation uses subtraction of multiples of ten and Grade 4 angle facts.

candidate.annotationRationale: The displayed calculation fits cnm_p065. The retained explanation interprets the difference using the right-angle measure and obtuse-angle classification in cnm_p101, supported locally by whole-minus-part reasoning in cnm_p035. Angle classification is not an additional task requirement. The supplied AI-generated English machine translation is retained; no teacher review is recorded.
candidate.changeReason: A right angle measures 90 degrees, and 120 degrees exceeds it by 30 degrees. The current explanation already states the correct requested difference.

review.mathematicalCheck: Since a right angle measures 90 degrees, the stated excess of 30 degrees gives \(120-90=30\). The classification is also valid because \(90<120<180\).
review.levelCheck: The arithmetic and angle facts are appropriate for Grade 4.
review.methodDistinctness: One complete comparison method is sufficient.
review.annotationCheck: cnm_p065 fits the subtraction of multiples of ten. cnm_p101 and cnm_p035 support the actual comparison route without making angle classification an assessed requirement.
review.preservationCheck: The current explanation is preserved byte-for-byte. It already states the requested difference, so a prose revision would be unnecessary.
review.provenanceCheck: The compiled solution remains retained upstream text. Attribution, source revision, CC-BY-NC-4.0 license and AI translation/review status survive; only review and annotations are project contributions.
